describes: packages/plugin/stamp: loose and canonical assets, removal, and the per-library mutation queue.

cases.name: a-raster-asset-is-sniffed-and-previews-itself
cases.covers: addAsset without a library sniffs a PNG's or JPEG's size, keeps its bytes as its own preview, and adds a loose single-asset library named after it; kind, subject and categories ride along.

cases.name: supplied-previews-and-sizes
cases.covers: An explicit size wins over the sniffed one; a supplied preview wins over the raster's own bytes and keeps its payload MIME type, which defaults to image/png when absent or empty.

cases.name: a-loose-pdf-needs-a-size
cases.covers: A PDF added without a library needs size (PDF bytes carry none): without it the call rejects and nothing is added; with it the asset is a vector with no preview unless one is supplied.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] a PDF asset needs `size` (its page size in points) — PDF bytes carry no sniffable dimensions

cases.name: asset-sources-that-are-refused
cases.covers: An unknown libraryId rejects with NotFound before reading the source; bytes that are not PNG, JPEG or PDF reject with InvalidArg; a non-source rejects with resolveBinarySource's TypeError, and a bad preview with its own.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] unknown library 'missing'

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] asset source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

$error.message: [stamp] asset source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: Cannot destructure property 'data' of 'source' as it is null.

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'arrayBuffer')

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] asset source must be PNG, JPEG, or single-page PDF bytes

cases.name: into-an-existing-loose-library
cases.covers: addAsset with a loose library's id queues on that library and appends the asset; an empty libraryId is no library at all.

cases.name: appends-a-page-to-a-canonical-library
cases.covers: addAsset on a canonical library reopens its canonical bytes, inserts the PDF, writes the page PieceInfo, extracts and renders the new page, saves the rewritten library and closes; the asset takes the inserted page size.

cases.name: a-supplied-preview-skips-the-render
cases.covers: An append with a supplied preview keeps it and renders nothing; the kind defaults to stamp.

cases.name: appends-that-are-refused
cases.covers: A raster cannot join a canonical library (rejected before any engine call); an insert of more than one page, an inserted page missing from the layout, a document without page pieceInfo and an inserted page the handle does not know each reject after closing the document, adding nothing.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] raster assets cannot be appended to a canonical PDF library

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] a canonical library asset must be a single-page PDF

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical PDF libraries need page layout and pieceInfo support

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical PDF libraries need page layout and pieceInfo support

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: no page 555

cases.name: an-unsaved-append-changes-nothing
cases.covers: A save that fails rejects the append after closing; the store and the canonical bytes are as they were, and the next append starts from them.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: save failed

cases.name: a-save-that-answers-nothing
cases.covers: An engine whose save and extract answer nothing leaves the library with no canonical bytes and the asset with none: the selectors read null, and an append or a removal on that library rejects with Unknown before opening anything.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical bytes are missing for library 'stamp-lib-0-1'

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical bytes are missing for library 'stamp-lib-0-1'

cases.name: removes-a-canonical-page-first
cases.covers: removeAsset on a canonical library with other assets deletes its page from the canonical bytes and saves them before the descriptor goes; an unknown id resolves and does nothing.

cases.name: removing-the-last-page-drops-the-library
cases.covers: Removing a canonical library's only asset drops the whole library instead of saving a zero-page PDF; a loose asset goes without any engine call and leaves its library.

cases.name: a-failed-page-delete-keeps-the-asset
cases.covers: A delete or save that fails rejects removeAsset after closing, and the asset, its binaries and the canonical bytes stay.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: locked

cases.name: removals-are-serialized-per-library
cases.covers: Removals on one library run one after the other: the first rewrite leaves one page, so the queued second drops the library rather than saving an empty PDF, and a third for the same asset finds it gone and does nothing. A removal on another library does not wait.

cases.name: remove-library
cases.covers: removeLibrary drops the library, its assets, their binaries and its canonical bytes; an unknown id still dispatches LIBRARY_REMOVED, which changes nothing.

cases.name: an-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
cases.covers: An append queued behind a removal and a removeLibrary of the same library finds it gone when its turn comes and rejects with NotFound; the removal's rewrite still lands first.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical library 'stamp-lib-0-1' no longer exists

cases.name: a-loose-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
cases.covers: A session id is not checked against the store: a loose library created while a canonical removal on the same id is in flight replaces the canonical one. A loose append queued behind that removal and a removeLibrary finds the library gone and rejects with NotFound.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] loose library 'stamp-lib-0-2' no longer exists

cases.name: a-loose-append-finds-its-library-canonical
cases.covers: A loose append queued on a library that an import has since replaced with a canonical one finds a library that is not loose when its turn comes, and rejects with NotFound.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] loose library 'stamp-lib-0-3' no longer exists

cases.name: a-loose-asset-under-a-canonical-id
cases.covers: An import that lands after a loose library took its embedded id replaces the library with the canonical one; removing the loose asset then finds a canonical library it has no page in and rejects with Unknown.

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] canonical asset 'stamp-0-2' has no page object number

cases.name: a-queued-mutation-after-destroy
cases.covers: A mutation still queued when the kernel is destroyed runs against a destroyed store: the in-flight removal's dispatch lands nowhere, and the queued append's read of the state throws a TypeError.

$error.name: TypeError
$error.message: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'libraries')
